description: Look up a district, county or department by code or name. Deep adds area, population and seat on paid plans. Pass state to resolve a colliding name. Population includes a reporting year or period when verified. Paid deep property_tax contains annual_median, currency and period: median annual tax payable on owner-occupied homes in the area, adjusted to the final year of that period. It is not a rate or property bill. Unsupported, missing and censored estimates are null.

code.description: District code or name, e.g. 37081, guilford county

country.description: ISO2, ISO3, or a country name. Optional when the lookup is unique.

deep.description: Include the complete detail bag on a paid plan.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

state.description: ADM1 code or name to disambiguate, e.g. NC or louisiana

name: district
